Name: Deluxe Shed
Author: genevieve310
Description:
[b][size=4]Overview[/size][/b]
This mod adds the ability to upgrade a Big Shed to a Deluxe Shed, that is twice the size of a Big Shed. Why does it cost so much? Because Casks are enabled by default. Fits 277 kegs in optimal layout and 413 casks when completely filled.

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]
It's your game so there are config options for enabling casks, building cost, and building material amounts:
[list]
[*]Use Big Shed Texture [i](default: false)[/i]: setting to true will switch deluxe shed to use big shed texture, thus allowing compatibility with retexture mods
[*]Allow Casks [i](default: true)[/i]: turn on/off casks working in deluxe shed
[*]Building Cost [i](default: 100000)[/i]: set the amount of g the deluxe shed costs to build. As a point of reference, if you turn off allowing casks, 30000 seems vanilla fair.
[*](Building Resources) Wood Amount [i](default: 500)[/i]: the number of pieces of wood needed to build the deluxe shed
[*](Building Resources) Hardwood Amount [i](default: 100)[/i]: the number of pieces of hardwood needed to build the deluxe shed
[/list]
Not enough config options? Then feel free to edit the content.json file directly!
